method: Evidence-based regeneration. Catalog rows derive their status from the live production backend (voice_commands.REGISTRY / _BACKENDS + dashboard_ops.EXTRA_OPS), the declared interfaces (catalog), the live CLI parser tree, the registry voice surface, and an AST scan of tests/ for a proving caller. A plugin/page row declares only the dashboard surface (no CLI/voice by design); it is IMPLEMENTED when a tests/ test reaching a real production dashboard route references its row id (directly or through a module constant), else UNVERIFIED. IMPLEMENTED requires a resolvable backend, an on-disk proving test, and every applicable surface present (catalog ops use the catalog interfaces). An op proof is *linked*: the row id must reach a production dispatcher as an argument (or through an evidence table / parametrized value), so a docstring, comment, or unrelated assertion can never close a row. The direct source inventory is ingested last: every non-evidence inventory item is either matched to a real merged-ledger row, covered as a *parented surface* of an IMPLEMENTED parent capability (CLI option/positional -> its command family, model/provider entry -> model/proxy_providers, plugin asset/API/test/manifest -> its plugin, OpenClaw extension -> the audited OC-* capability, workflow source -> its area capability, dashboard component -> webui_status) with no standalone row, an upstream tool/skill/plugin item is given an explicit fork-runtime disposition (the in-process fork registry / skill tree / plugin fleet is the real backing surface; IMPLEMENTED with a proving test, else a typed GATED gate), or emitted as an explicit MISSING open row classified as a distinct capability or a parented surface needing parent closure; absent or malformed inventories are recorded, never treated as complete. No status is hand-flipped.

provenance.evidence: production backend + declared interfaces + live CLI tree + voice registry + linked tests/ AST proofs + direct source inventory

Plugin providers resolve through the Qubit skill manifest registry. routes=1
Profile archives enter quarantine for review; a reviewed archive imports via the Qubit principal registry, never straight from the dashboard. routes=1
External voice catalogs (ElevenLabs) are not fetched; TTS runs through the local provider chain. routes=1

rows.dashboard: overlay Qubit Chat tab (POST /api/qubit/chat) + CLI `qubit tui`
rows.note: Qubit forbids raw shell/PTY spawn; the xterm mirror cannot attach. Use Qubit Chat (streaming agent turns) or the TUI live board. routes=4
Secret values never leave the vault; only references are listed. routes=8
Qubit sessions are append-only audit receipts; owner back-fill is not offered. Memory tombstones/corrections own forgetting. routes=5
Qubit owns the host shell surface; no remote SSH ownership nonce is minted or served to the dashboard. Host control stays with the operator. routes=1

rows.dashboard: CLI `qubit product_*` / package + dashboard Setup page
rows.note: In-place self-update from the dashboard is refused; upgrades are versioned, staged, and reversible. routes=5
The Hermes tui_gateway WS dialect is not served; Qubit keeps one event path (SSE feed + ops). Chat uses Qubit Chat. routes=2

rows.capability: In-process fork agent tool registry (pinned Hermes tools + toolsets)
rows.note: Every upstream agent tool/toolset is exposed by the vendored fork registry and dispatched in-process by the fork agent runtime under Qubit policy/broker; the Wave 5 test imports the live registry and asserts membership.

rows.capability: In-process fork skill runtime (vendored skills + optional-skills)
rows.note: Every vendored skill directory with a loadable SKILL.md is served by the in-process fork skill runtime; the Wave 5 test asserts each inventory skill is vendored and loadable.

rows.capability: In-process fork plugin fleet (vendored agent/provider/dashboard plugins)
rows.note: Every vendored non-dashboard plugin is covered by the Qubit plugin wrapper (voicebridge.hermes_plugins.VENDORED_PLUGIN_FLEET / plugin_fleet_audit); the Wave 5 test asserts the fleet covers every inventory plugin item.
Pending-confirmation banner on the shared journal (same records as CLI `qubit approvals`, voice yes/no, classic dashboard). Qubit-owned addition.
Kanban boards and cards on the canonical store (same backend as qubit kanban CLI and voice).
Qubit product identity (header mark + rebrand styles). Qubit-owned addition; upstream names stay only in legal/provenance records.
Qubit-native streaming-safe chat on the shared agent backend (same module as CLI and voice). Qubit-owned addition.
Browser, desktop, IDE, vision, and pinned-runtime availability (same runtime inventory and broker ops as `qubit runtime` CLI and voice).
Gateway records and link states (same backend as qubit gateway CLI).
Memory provider status, search, and the learning ledger (same MemoryStore/curator backend as CLI `qubit memory`/`lessons` and voice).
Canonical model/provider profiles: list, inspect capabilities, locality, egress, budgets and health, create (non-secret fields only), clone, test, session-select and rollback throu
Qubit operations console — every capability registry op with real arg forms, staged confirmations, receipts, and typed states (same dashboard_ops broker as CLI and voice).
Activity event log, usage analytics, generated report bundles, and insights (same journal/analytics/reports backend as CLI and voice).
Pinned runtime inventory and status (same backend as qubit runtime CLI and voice).
